card_config.value: Add this card to your hand, or if you have the required energy, perform Raid with it.

card_set: Booster Pack Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Vol.2 [UEX05BT]
card_text:
【Raid】 <Kyojuro Rengoku> Switch to active. May move to the front line.
[During Your Turn] If you have placed a card from your hand into your sideline with an ability on one of your event or <Kyojuro Rengoku> cards this turn, this character gains 500 BP and 【Impact (1)】.
[When Played] Place any number of cards from your hand into your sideline. Choose up to one character with {3000} or less BP on your opponent's front line and sideline it. For each card placed from your hand into your sideline with this ability, add 500 to the BP range of the character you may choose with this ability.

regulations.title: One Battle Rule Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba
